consumer: The frontend HP-bar renderer reading the snapshot to draw each visible monster's bar and ask 'what color band (green/yellow/red) does the GUI show for this hp:hp_max ratio?'
scope: per-visible-monster on-screen display view (only monsters the player currently sees), not raw world-wide state
decisive_source: src/arcopolis_export.cpp::write_entities(monsters) writes raw hp/hp_max integers (S ground truth), but the goal's consumer needs the GUI's banded/colored display view derived from that ratio, which the raw getters do not themselves format
divergence: A monster sitting exactly on a color-band boundary where the GUI's banding rounds/clamps to yellow while a naive hp/hp_max recompute lands on green (or a hallucination whose displayed bar differs from any raw-state recomputation) exposes that raw integers are not the displayed color authority
